title: Make a paragraph map
subtitle: Divide a passage into main claim, support, and response.
overview: A paragraph map names each clause’s job: main assertion, reason, condition, consequence, or response.
This is the bridge from sentence parsing to theological reading: you observe how claims are connected before explaining them.

items.grc: οὕτως γὰρ ἠγάπησεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν κόσμον ὥστε τὸν υἱὸν ἔδωκεν.
items.en: Main act: God loved; result expression: he gave the Son.

items.grc: ἵνα πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν μὴ ἀπόληται ἀλλ᾽ ἔχῃ ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
items.en: Purpose: that every believer may not perish but may have eternal life.
